name: imageReadSvg
description: Reads an SVG and rasterises it into an ordinary CFML image object, so the whole image* family (resize, crop, draw on, imageWrite to png/jpg/gif) applies to it. source is either a path to an .svg file or the SVG markup itself (strings containing <svg are treated as markup). With no dimensions the SVG's own size is used; with one, the other is derived from the aspect ratio; with both, the SVG is scaled to fit inside that box, preserving aspect ratio and centring the result. Text is rendered with the operating system's font database.

params.name: source
params.description: Path to an .svg file, or the SVG markup itself.

params.name: width
params.description: Optional target width in pixels; the height is derived from the aspect ratio when only one dimension is given.

params.name: height
params.description: Optional target height in pixels; when both dimensions are given the SVG is scaled to fit inside the box.

examples.title: Rasterise an SVG file
examples.description: Read an SVG at native size and write it as a PNG.

examples.title: Scale SVG markup
examples.description: Rasterise inline SVG markup into a 200x100 box.
